# Paracetamol for adults

Paracetamol is a common painkiller used to treat aches and pain.

## How and when to take paracetamol

The usual dose is one or two 500mg tablets up to 4 times in 24 hours.

Always leave at least 4 hours between doses.

## Side effects

Side effects are rare.
